issues.description: Fields visibility mismatch for Lecture attributes: The template file declares two attributes as public (lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents), the problem statement UML lists five attributes as private (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors), and the solution implementation declares all five attributes as private. This inconsistency can confuse students about intended encapsulation and may cause duplicate-field or compilation problems if students add the private attributes with the same names or rely on the public fields in the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java so its attribute declarations match the UML and the solution: declare the attributes as private and include all five fields (private String lectureName; private int numberOfInscribedStudents; private int numberOfGuestStudents; private int numberOfLecturers; private int numberOfTutors;). Alternatively, remove the two pre-declared public fields from the template so students implement the correct private attributes themselves. Ensure the template's visibility and attribute list are consistent with the problem statement to avoid student confusion and duplicate-field errors.
